steps.content:
You should buy from **Seller A - Ottervale Audio** - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/ygdqhx/a

The two sellers are offering the **exact same product for the exact same price and terms** on everything except the return policy:

| | **A: Ottervale Audio** | **B: Brackmoor Sound** |
|---|---|---|
| **Product** | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - Graphite | Same |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days | Same |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | Same |
| **Returns** | **Free 90-day returns** | **30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping** |

**Why A is better:**

Everything else is identical — same headphones, specs, price, shipping speed, rating, and warranty — so the return policy is the deciding factor.

Ottervale Audio gives you **3x longer to return (90 days vs 30 days)** and **doesn't charge you for return shipping**, while Brackmoor Sound requires you to pay for return shipping yourself and only gives you 30 days. That makes Ottervale much lower-risk if you don't like the fit/sound, or if you have an issue after the first month.

If returns don't matter to you, either seller is equivalent, but Ottervale Audio is strictly the better deal.
